:::{#exr-linear-map-practice}
#### Testing whether a difference of scaled measurements is a linear map

A score that scales two measurements and takes their difference,
such as $3 x_1 - x_2$,
is a common building block of a model.
Let $f: \reals^2 \to \reals$ be $f(\vx) = 3 x_1 - x_2$.

Is $f$ a [linear map](#def-linear-map)?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Check the two conditions in @def-linear-map one at a time,
for any $\vx, \vy \in \reals^2$ and $c \in \reals$.

:::

:::
